agent_review.author: agent

findings.observed_fact: The team entered Sunflora with Birdlaw at 19 HP, then whiteouted after repeated forced switches and no successful damage line.
findings.strategic_judgment: The prepared line did not preserve a viable Sunflora answer; this is not live-qualified.
findings.next_test: Stop policy iteration and prepare a stronger Sunflora converter; both bounded turn-22 tests showed the current Croakatoa/Rampage survivors still fail on their next damage exchange.

resolution.observed: Preparation replaced Rampage with the same Coppertop personality 4082287436 used in clean authoritative clone review c02028bc9208374c73f3. In that replay, Coppertop absorbed Eelektrik's Super Fang at turns 10-11, Croakatoa finished Eelektrik at turns 12-15, Birdlaw entered Sunflora at full 46 HP and KO'd it at turns 16-18, and the battle ended in a verified win at turn 22. Live RAM now verifies Coppertop Lv17 at 56/56 HP in the prepared party.
resolution.remaining_issue: This resolves the structural preparation defect only; the current Cufant behavior bundle still requires three new clean reviewed clone wins before live execution.

findings.observed_fact: After Fake Out poisoned Eelektrik, the policy alternated Lildozer and Birdlaw through six voluntary switches; neither line dealt damage and each entry accepted another hit.
findings.strategic_judgment: Immediate switch reversal must be blocked when it is not a forced switch or an explicit matchup directive. A pivot that has already failed to create progress is not a plan.
findings.next_test: Replay turn 17 and verify that the reverse switch is vetoed and a legal damage action is selected.

resolution.observed: From pre-state 47f065a29fc059c2, after two consecutive switches, all four voluntary switch candidates received history:switch_stall_after_two and the policy selected Birdlaw Quick Attack; no voluntary switch was submitted.
resolution.remaining_issue: Birdlaw still fainted to the verified Shock Wave; that survival failure remains tracked by the separate preparation and reserve findings.

findings.observed_fact: After Lildozer's first Bulldoze, the policy switched to Ohmnomnom; Ponyta's Flame Wheel immediately fainted Ohmnomnom.
findings.strategic_judgment: The Ponyta switch was not a safe conversion. The current reserve rule protected Rampage but did not identify a survivable immediate line.
findings.next_test: Bounded-replay the turn-6 state with the surviving alternatives and select only a line that preserves a live Eelektrik answer.

resolution.observed: After removing the stale Rampage veto, the current policy selected Rampage from pre-state fa5a8838639ed822; the authoritative replay verified Ponyta Flame Wheel was not very effective and Rampage reached the command menu alive.
resolution.remaining_issue: This preserves the Eelektrik reserve but does not by itself prove the complete fight.

findings.observed_fact: Birdlaw was left active at 19 HP to attack Sunflora and was KO'd by Sludge Bomb before establishing a safe line.
findings.strategic_judgment: A nearly defeated finisher was spent as the next lead instead of handing the matchup to a healthier converter.
findings.next_test: Replay the turn-22 state with Croakatoa and Rampage once each; retain the option with an observed surviving damage turn.

resolution.observed: Clean clone c02028bc9208374c73f3 verifies the Cufant handoff preserved Birdlaw at 46/46 through Eelektrik, then Birdlaw safely entered Sunflora, survived Leech Seed, and used two Aerial Aces to KO it. This directly corrects the old 19-HP Birdlaw reserve handoff.
resolution.remaining_issue: The current individuals and current behavior hash must reproduce the handoff in fresh clones.

findings.observed_fact: The Eelektrik line consumed twelve actions and seven switches after the poison landed, with only Birdlaw's final Aerial Ace dealing the finishing damage.
findings.strategic_judgment: Even though poison eventually created progress, the line spent too much HP and tempo on immunity pivots.
findings.next_test: Compare one committed Croakatoa damage line against the old pivot sequence from turn 15.

findings.observed_fact: The forced-switch phase used ten additional actions while preserving no winning resource.
findings.strategic_judgment: This is a consequence of the earlier failures, but the review should track it as avoidable tempo loss once the converter line is fixed.
findings.next_test: Re-measure after the Eelektrik handoff is corrected.

correct_choices: The opening Bushtank Razor Leaf into Bibarel and Croakatoa Fake Out were legal, fresh-entry actions.
Poisoning Eelektrik with Fake Out's Poison Touch was useful verified progress.
The review correctly treats the forced post-faint switches separately from voluntary switch decisions.
No new clone or live fight is permitted until every attached critical/high finding has replay evidence and resolution.
agent_review.next_test: Implement and unit-test the voluntary immediate-reversal guard, then replay turn 17 once; separately replay the turn-6 and turn-22 attached states before changing the Gavi line.
